fkVsRelation: No relation needed. If policy becomes independent entity, ordinary policyId reference suffices; do not persist private text in relation labels.
lossVsFriction: B: nullable fields alone cannot distinguish suppressed, unavailable and empty; explicit business status preserves that distinction. This is business modeling responsibility, not missing Core primitive.
testPropositions: Roundtrip key=null/contentState suppressed differs from key=""/state observed
Ensure raw payload, hash and auxiliary fields contain no suppressed key content
reason: Frozen Core supports the declared business shape; semantic constraints remain collector responsibilities.
sourceFieldNote: Properties include documented source fields plus explicitly named collector-derived identity/status/evidence fields; exact mapping described in evidence and prose. Fixture values are synthetic unless tagged observed synthetic local sample.
